quantity: the store side, which is storage and not memory (R-13-010c)

predicates.git ls-tree -r -l: every blob git ls-tree -r -l reports at the named revision, sized by the blob's own byte length and named by its object id; a gitlink is counted as neither a file nor a byte; the union credits one object per distinct id once
predicates.store.py: every regular non-symlink file under each root, filtered by suffix where given, sized by st_size and named by the SHA-256 of its bytes; the union credits one object per distinct digest exactly once

deduplication: R-13-008 makes a transfer a set difference, so a content-addressed store holds one object per distinct content name. Each row's unique_bytes credits that inside the row. The union below credits it once across every row of one instrument. The two instruments name objects by different digests, but the rows they measure are disjoint by kind, source blobs of two repositories against built objects of a compiler and of a prover, and the two git closures were measured together and share no blob id, so the cross-instrument total has nothing left to credit.
declared_device_capacity: absent. R-18-004b prices two memory classes, bandwidth, area, yield and unit cost and names no storage capacity; the product-gate contract's declared parameters are DP-1, DP-2, DP-3, DP-4 and DP-5, with no storage row, and every one is proposed. The comparison this quantity is to be scored by is therefore owed, not made.
